thread:
Maya: Quick thread - getting this team aligned on GA readiness criteria for the new slice model. Need concrete acceptance items we can present tomorrow.
Tom: I'll own the SLA language and pricing guardrails. Initial proposal: Hosted SLA = 99.9% availability, p95 text-gen latency <150ms under normal load. Dedicated = contract SLA with higher SLOs + reserved capacity.
Elena: I'll take docs. Plan: public one-pager + internal runbook with playbooks, test vectors, and example prompts. Public doc short, link to support/enterprise KB for Dedicated.
Chris: Oncall ops: recommend escalation timelines: P0 immediate page, P1 page within 15m, P2 async weekdays. For Hosted we need 24/7 paging; Dedicated can have dedicated rotation optionally.
Alex: For Dedicated customers, we should require a signed capacity reservation and a canary window before GA onboarding. Also include a billing SLA clause for credits if we miss contractual latency SLAs.
sre-bot: Suggestion: add synthetic canary check every 5m for staging and hourly for prod. Add metric group: "slice.latency.p95", "slice.queue.depth", "slice.model_fallbacks", "slice.error.rate".
Maya: Acceptance gates (draft): 1) SLA sim + load test pass, 2) Public docs + internal runbook published, 3) Oncall rota + documented escalation, 4) Pricing/quota policy + soft/hard limits, 5) 24h synthetic smoke stability in staging -> green. Agree?
Tom: Agree. Pricing/quota detail: soft limit at 80% baseline with email alert to customer and support; auto-throttle at 95% for shared pools. We'll add override path for Dedicated.
Elena: I will publish the public stub and include the FAQ around fallbacks and expected behaviors (e.g., model-variant routing). Internal runbook will include step-by-step incident runbook and sample postmortem checklist.
Chris: I'll wire up the dashboards: per-slice cost per 1M tokens, tail latency heatmap, queue length alarm. I'll also add playbook steps for capacity alarms (escalate infra after 15m).
Alex: Also recommend contractual onboarding checklist for Dedicated: network setup, KMS keys, observability hook, and a 2-hour capacity ramp test.
Maya: Ownership: Product = Maya, SLA & pricing = Tom, Docs = Elena, Oncall/playbooks = Chris, Dedicated contracts = Alex. Call for final acks.
Tom: Ack. I'll attach a sample quota policy doc by EOD.
Elena: Ack. Publishing stub now, internal runbook tomorrow morning.
Chris: Ack. Dashboard + synthetic checks will be staged by Friday AM.
Alex: Ack. Draft dedicated appendix ready Friday EOD.
Maya: Thanks. I'll compile a single-page launch checklist and send to execs before EOD Friday. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
